app.hook_feature_and_call_to_action_scen: Hook, feature, and call-to-action scenes on bold colour pages.
app.one_full_bleed_color_page_with_a_lar: One full-bleed colour page with a large centred statement.
brands.ai_not_connected_hint: Connect an AI provider in workspace settings to also get a suggested voice and font pairing. Logos and colours work without one.
brands.export_check_block_rule: Exports are blocked until off-brand colours, fonts, and logos are fixed
brands.export_check_warn_hint: Point out off-brand colours, fonts, and logos, and still allow export.
brands.export_check_warn_rule: Exports warn about off-brand colours, fonts, and logos
brands.list_hint: Logos, colours, fonts, and voice that everyone in the workspace designs with.
brands.lock_colors: Lock colours to the brand palette
brands.lock_colors_hint: Designs can only use the kit's colours.
brands.no_new_colors_in_logo: The logo has no colours the palette does not already have.
brands.no_text_pairs: No two of these colours are readable together as body text (4.5:1).
brands.start_from_logo_hint: Upload a logo to take its colours and make a version for dark backgrounds.
brands.start_from_logo_hint_ai: Upload a logo to take its colours, make a version for dark backgrounds, and get a suggested voice and fonts.
brands.start_from_scratch_hint: Fill in the logo, colours, fonts, and voice step by step.
brands.start_from_website_hint: Enter the company's website to pick up its logo, colours, and fonts.
brands.start_from_website_hint_ai: Enter the company's website to pick up its logo, colours, and fonts, and get a suggested voice.
dashboard.no_favorites_yet_tap_the_star_: No favourites yet. Tap the star on a design to add it here.
editor.analyze_this_page_for_contrast_of: Analyse this page for contrast, off-canvas, alignment, spacing, and readability issues.
editor.collapse_fonts_snap_colors_to_a_f: Collapse fonts, snap colours to a few roles, and unify corner radii across the page.
editor.how_this_color_appears_with_the_s: How this colour appears with the selected colour-vision type
editor.map_this_color_to_a_brand_swatch_: Map this colour to a brand swatch, or keep the original
editor.no_favorites_yet_tap_the_star_on_: No favourites yet. Tap the star on any asset.
editor.pick_a_color_from_the_screen: Pick a colour from the screen
editor.skip_no_stickies: there are no sticky notes to summarise
editor.vectorize_hint: Works best on logos, icons and flat illustrations. The image is replaced by a group of vector shapes, one per colour; undo brings the image back.
dashboard.print_profiles_hint: ICC profiles for everyone in this workspace: CMYK print files (PDF, TIFF, EPS) are made through them and exact print colours are shown on screen through them. Owners and admins add them.
editor.tiff_desc: Print-ready image in CMYK or RGB with the colour profile embedded
editor.intent_relative: Relative colorimetric (exact in-gamut colours, brand colours)
editor.intent_perceptual: Perceptual (smooth for photos with vivid colours)
editor.black_ink_only_desc: Pure black prints as 100% K instead of a four-colour mix, so small text stays sharp even if the plates are slightly misaligned.
errors.print_profile_missing: Choose a colour profile for the CMYK export.
editor.make_editable_tooltip: Turn this SVG into shapes so colours and parts can be edited
editor.proof_note: Computed from the screen rendering through the chosen colour profile: a close estimate. “Check output” separates the real file.
editor.output_cmyk_only: CMYK and spot colours only, no RGB.
editor.output_no_output_intent: No output intent: the print shop cannot tell which colour profile the file was made for.
editor.print_cmyk_hint: Print files (vector PDF, EPS) carry exactly these values, not converted through the colour profile.
editor.spot_color_name_first: Enter the name the print shop uses for the colour.
settings.my_print_profiles_hint: ICC profiles of your own, for CMYK print files and for showing exact print colours on screen. Only you see them, in every workspace. Profiles for everyone in a workspace are on its Members page, under Print and export.
editor.design_color_profile_hint: Exact CMYK and spot colours are shown on screen as they print with this profile; the download menu starts with it.
editor.print_profile_upload_tip: For coated paper, upload your print shop's profile (e.g. PSO Coated v3) under Settings › Colour profiles, or ask a workspace admin to add it for everyone.
editor.round_to_mm_desc: Each design goes out at its nearest whole-millimetre size (89.96 × 39.95 mm becomes 90 × 40 mm). The designs themselves stay as they are.
dashboard.reformat_fit_scale_desc: Everything grows or shrinks by one factor, so text keeps its line breaks; the space left over is shared out, and colour areas along an edge stretch with it.
dashboard.print_and_export_hint: Colour profiles, export profiles and print presets for everyone in this workspace. Your own, which only you see, are in
dashboard.print_profile_not_usable: This file is not a usable CMYK colour profile. Colour profiles are .icc files for a printing condition, e.g. PSO Coated v3.
errors.api_print_profile_forbidden: Only workspace admins can manage colour profiles.
errors.api_print_profile_not_found: That colour profile no longer exists.
errors.api_print_profile_not_cmyk: This file is not an ICC CMYK colour profile.
roles.hint_brand_kits: Create, change and delete brands: colours, fonts, logos, voice, rules and versions. Includes the brand library.
roles.hint_print_color_profiles: Add and remove the workspace's ICC colour profiles and colour libraries.
brand.new_brand_hint: Start empty, or take colours, fonts and the logo from a logo, a website or a kit file.
brand.delete_brand_hint: Designs made with this brand stay exactly as they are: their colours, fonts, logos and graphics are stored in the design, and the uploads stay.
brand.colors_hint: The brand's colours with their print values. Add a colour by picker or hex value; colours from a design's selection or page are added from the brand panel in the editor.
brand.colors_hint_read_only: The brand's colours with their print values. Use them in the editor from the brand panel.
roles.hint_brand_library: Upload, rename, move and remove a brand's categories and graphics. Colours, fonts and logos stay as they are.
brand.lint_color: Colour {hex} is not one of the brand's colours.
brand.lint_logo_recolor: The logo has been recoloured. Use one of its versions instead.
brand.color_pantone_hint: The colour book reference the brand names for this colour, for example PANTONE 7741 C. It goes into the colour list of print exports; printing still goes by the colour's values.
dashboard.color_libraries_hint: Colour books and house colour lists for the colour list of print exports: every colour of a design gets the nearest entry and its distance (ΔE 2000). No colour books come with the app; upload only books your workspace holds a licence for.
dashboard.color_libraries_upload_hint: Adobe Swatch Exchange (.ase), Adobe Color Book (.acb), CxF (.cxf), CGATS (.txt) with Lab, CMYK or measured spectra, or CSV (name;L;a;b, name;C;M;Y;K in percent, or name;#rrggbb). You see what was read before it is stored; only the colour entries are kept.
dashboard.could_not_upload_color_library: Could not add the colour library.
dashboard.could_not_remove_color_library: Could not remove the colour library.
editor.color_list_desc: Every colour of the design in all common codes (hex, RGB, HSL, HSB, CMYK, Lab, LCh), with what the print file carries, the brand colour with its Pantone reference and the nearest colour of each colour library.
editor.color_list_no_libraries_hint: Colour libraries are added in the workspace under Print and export.
editor.color_list_images.one: {count} picture is not listed: its colours go through the colour profile pixel by pixel.
editor.color_list_images.other: {count} pictures are not listed: their colours go through the colour profile pixel by pixel.
editor.color_list_note: Lab is worked out from the CMYK through the colour profile (absolute colorimetric, D50), as it prints on the profile's paper. The nearest library colour is a reference with its distance (dE 2000: below 1 hardly visible, below 2 small), not a proof: compare with the printed colour book. The print file is not changed by this list.
errors.api_color_library_forbidden: You may not manage the colour libraries of this workspace.
errors.api_color_library_invalid: The colour library is not valid (no colours, too many, or a value out of range).
errors.api_color_library_not_found: That colour library no longer exists.
errors.api_color_library_too_large: The colour library is too large.
dashboard.package_export_hint: Import it on the other instance under Projects, Import, danvas package. Version history, comments and share links stay here. Font files are passed on with the package: only share it where the fonts' licences allow.
brand.delete_palette_message.one: “{name}” holds {count} colour. It is taken out of the brand; designs that use it do not change.
brand.delete_palette_message.other: “{name}” holds {count} colours. They are taken out of the brand; designs that use them do not change.
brand.palette_empty: No colours yet: add one below.
dashboard.color_library_error_acb_space: the colour book uses a colour space that is not read (only RGB, CMYK and Lab).
dashboard.color_library_error_too_many: it holds {found} colours; a library takes at most {max}.
dashboard.color_library_read_cmyk.one: {count} as CMYK only (Lab through the workspace's default colour profile)
dashboard.color_library_read_cmyk.other: {count} as CMYK only (Lab through the workspace's default colour profile)
dashboard.color_library_read_skipped.one: {count} entry of the file has no usable colour and is left out
dashboard.color_library_read_skipped.oth: {count} entries of the file have no usable colour and are left out
editor.color_list_profile_of_design: the design's colour profile (the download is not CMYK)
roles.hint_design_color_list: Add a design's colour list to a download: every colour in every code, the brand's references and the nearest colours of the workspace's colour libraries (PDF, CSV, swatches).
editor.color_list_profile_desc: Every download with this profile comes with the colour list, for people whose role may add it.
brand.copy_hint: Colours, fonts with their files, logos, graphics and settings come along; the uploads are copied into the workspace. The brands here stay as they are.
